name: @etzhayyim/github-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of github (public GitHub-data catalog: public repos + profiles + issues + org membership graph) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW). (c) mixed split: public crawled GitHub data (external authority github.com) migrates; authenticated private-repo github-sync (token custody) + commit-analysis compute stay etzhayyim via consent-capability. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
